# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_EXPANSION_BREAKOUT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
After a period of extreme EMA‑ribbon contraction, an expansion bar closing below the fast EMA with strong volume signals a short‑term breakdown. This captures momentum exhaustion following low volatility compression, distinct from rejection-based entries.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: IF ribbon width (EMA55 - EMA8) <= 10th percentile of its last 20 values AND current candle close < EMA8 AND candle body > 1.5 * ATR(5) AND volume > 1.3 * average volume THEN enter short at the close of that bar.
Exit shape: chart‑stop at the most recent swing high (prior HH) invalidation, TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail using a chandelier exit (ATR*3) from the highest high.
Regime hint: Optimal when VIX is between 15‑25 and time between 10:00‑14:00 ET.
